title: Telegram Messenger App - App Store
excerpt: Download Telegram Messenger by Telegram FZ-LLC on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Telegram Messenger.
content_html:
Fast. Secure. Powerful.

Free · In‑App Purchases

Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users. FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe. SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again. UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork. RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs. SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it. PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads. For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient. We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today. sentences.en: Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices.
sentences.zh: 纯粹的即时消息传递 — 简单、快速、安全，并在您的所有设备上同步。

sentences.en: One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.
sentences.zh: 全球下载次数最多的 5 个应用程序之一，拥有超过 10 亿活跃用户。

sentences.en: FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.
sentences.zh: 快速：Telegram 是市场上最快的消息应用程序，通过全球独特的分布式数据中心网络将人们联系起来。

sentences.en: SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once.
sentences.zh: 已同步：您可以同时访问所有手机、平板电脑和计算机上的消息。

sentences.en: Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected.
sentences.zh: Telegram 应用程序是独立的，因此您无需保持手机连接。

sentences.en: Start typing on one device and finish the message from another.
sentences.zh: 在一台设备上开始打字，然后在另一台设备上完成消息。
再也不会丢失您的数据。

sentences.en: UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size.
sentences.zh: 无限制：您可以发送媒体和文件，对其类型和大小没有任何限制。

sentences.en: Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it.
sentences.zh: 您的整个聊天记录不需要设备上的磁盘空间，并且只要您需要，就会安全地存储在 Telegram 云中。

sentences.en: SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use.
sentences.zh: 安全：我们的使命是提供最佳的安全性和易用性。

sentences.en: Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange.
sentences.zh: Telegram 上的所有内容（包括聊天、群组、媒体等）均使用 256 位对称 AES 加密、2048 位 RSA 加密和 Diffie-Hellman 安全密钥交换的组合进行加密。

sentences.en: 100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published.
sentences.zh: 100% 免费和开放：Telegram 为开发人员提供完整记录的免费 API、开源应用程序和可验证的构建，以证明您下载的应用程序是根据已发布的完全相同的源代码构建的。

sentences.en: POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks.
sentences.zh: 功能强大：您可以与最多 200,000 名成员创建群聊，共享大型视频、任何类型的文档（.DOCX、.MP3、.ZIP 等），每个文档最多 2 GB，甚至可以为特定任务设置机器人。

sentences.en: Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.
sentences.zh: Telegram 是托管在线社区和协调团队合作的完美工具。

sentences.en: RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made.
sentences.zh: 可靠：Telegram 旨在使用尽可能少的数据传递消息，是有史以来最可靠的消息传递系统。

sentences.en: It works even on the weakest mobile connections.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可以在最弱的移动连接上工作。

sentences.en: FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.
sentences.zh: 乐趣：Telegram 拥有强大的照片和视频编辑工具、动画贴纸和表情符号、完全可定制的主题来更改应用程序的外观，以及开放的贴纸/GIF 平台来满足您所有的表达需求。

sentences.en: SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean.
sentences.zh: 简单：在提供前所未有的一系列功能的同时，我们非常注意保持界面简洁。

sentences.en: Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.
sentences.zh: Telegram 非常简单，您已经知道如何使用它。

sentences.en: PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data.
sentences.zh: 隐私：我们认真对待您的隐私，绝不会让任何第三方访问您的数据。

sentences.en: You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace.
sentences.zh: 您可以随时删除您为双方发送或接收的任何消息，且不留任何痕迹。

sentences.en: Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.
sentences.zh: Telegram 绝不会使用您的数据向您展示广告。

sentences.en: For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats.
sentences.zh: 对于那些对最大程度的隐私感兴趣的人，Telegram 提供秘密聊天。

sentences.en: Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices.
sentences.zh: 秘密聊天消息可以通过编程从参与的设备自动自毁。

sentences.en: This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，您可以发送所有类型的消失内容 - 消息、照片、视频，甚至文件。

sentences.en: Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.
sentences.zh: 秘密聊天使用端到端加密来确保消息只能由其预期收件人阅读。

sentences.en: We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app.
sentences.zh: 我们不断拓展消息应用程序的功能范围。

sentences.en: Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.
sentences.zh: 不要等很多年才让老通讯工具赶上 Telegram——今天就加入革命吧。
